Privacy Policy

Last updated: date

1. Who is responsible

The controller for data processing on this website is company name and address (see Imprint).

2. What we collect and why

  • Quote requests: club name, contact name, email, phone, sport, team size, message and uploaded logos — to prepare your quote and mockup. Legal basis
  • Size lists and kit specs you send from the size guide or customisation page — stored only in your own browser until you submit the form.
  • Server logs: describe hosting provider and log retention

3. Services we use

  • Analytics: none / name of tool

Retention periods

5. Your rights

You have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict processing of your data, to data portability and to object, and to complain to a supervisory authority. Contact for privacy requests

This site does not set tracking cookies. Update if analytics or embeds are added
